newH03FutureNegatives.expectedSafeDisposition: No resource M09 grant or M11 process admission.
No public endpoint or metadata projection.
No OS process liveness or owner ability to reap.

newH03FutureNegatives.trigger: Same question routed to multiple owners
newH03FutureNegatives.expectedSafeDisposition: One owner response never signs another owner decision.

newH03FutureNegatives.trigger: Remote endpoint reachable or third-party registration
newH03FutureNegatives.expectedSafeDisposition: No authentic principal/tenant permission or network egress.

newH03FutureNegatives.trigger: Existing process PID or captured stale handle
newH03FutureNegatives.expectedSafeDisposition: No right to signal/reap, no inference of process identity.
No publication even when positive grant absent.

newH03FutureNegatives.trigger: Partial ACK or claimed process exit
newH03FutureNegatives.expectedSafeDisposition: No owner-verified resource reclaim or M06 completion.

stop: Four packets are independently owner-addressed source quotations and open questions, not approvals. Even a later valid M09 B receipt cannot replace M12 placement, M54 permission, M58 publication/negative-only exposure or M60 OS/platform rights. H01-H04 remain OPEN HIGH until separately source-verified independent owners sign off.
